observations.body: Wisdom is spoken and discerned through the Spirit. We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing. “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.

payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 2:6–16 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states wisdom is spoken and discerned through the Spirit. We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing. “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
